forms.fn2-rs-int-valuesp:
(defun fn2-rs-int-valuesp (value)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom value) t
  (and (consp (car value)) (not (eq (cadar value) :digest)) (not (fn2-rs-octetsp (cadar value)))
       (fn2-rs-int-valuesp (cdr value)))))
forms.fn2-defrunschema:
(defun fn2-defrunschema (name id key value merge page-kind fold)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let* ((entry (fn2-rs-sym name "-ENTRY")) (index (fn2-rs-sym name "-INDEX")) (run (fn2-rs-sym name "-RUN"))
        (cmp (fn2-rs-sym name "-COMPARE")) (layout (append key value)))
  (cond ((not (and (symbolp name) (natp id) (consp key) (fn2-rs-keyp key) (fn2-layoutp layout)
                   (<= (len layout) *fn2-run-key-fields-max*)
                   (member-eq merge '(:union :latest :unique))
                   ;; a :union payload is integers, so stage compares it whole
                   (or (not (eq merge :union)) (fn2-rs-int-valuesp value))
                   (member-eq page-kind '(:run-data :manifest))
                   (or (null fold) (fn2-rf-okp fold key value merge))))
         `(make-event (er soft 'defrunschema "Malformed run schema ~x0." ',name)))
        (t
         `(progn
           (deflayout ,entry ',layout)
           (deflayout ,index ',(fn2-rs-index-layout key))
           (deflayout ,run ',(fn2-rs-run-layout key))
           ,(fn2-rs-shape-assertion name (len key))
           ,(fn2-declare (list :schema name)
              (list :id id :key key :value value :merge merge :page-kind page-kind
                    :layouts (list entry index run) :compare cmp :fold fold)
              nil
              (append (fn2-rs-compare-events name entry key) (and fold (fn2-rf-events name key value fold))))
           ,@(and fold (fn2-rf-logic-events name key value fold)))))))
forms.defrunschema:
(defmacro defrunschema (name &key id key value merge (page-kind ':run-data) fold)
 `(progn
   (make-event
    (if (fn2-rs-assembled (w state))
        (er soft 'defrunschema "Schema ~x0 is declared after the run assembly." ',name)
      (value '(value-triple :unassembled))))
   ,(fn2-defrunschema name id key value merge page-kind fold)))
forms.fn2-rf-events:
(defun fn2-rf-events (name key value fold)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let* ((evs (cadr (member-eq :events fold))) (vnames (strip-cars value)) (nv (len value)) (nk (len key)))
  `((defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-EVENTP") (e)
     (declare (xargs :guard t))
     (and (consp e) (true-listp e) (case (car e) ,@(fn2-rf-eventp-arms evs key) (otherwise nil))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-APPLY") (kind vbase abase fn2-fields)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp vbase) (natp abase))))
     (if (not (and (natp vbase) (natp abase)
                   (<= (+ vbase ,(+ nk nv)) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (<= (+ abase ,(fn2-rf-max-args evs)) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
         (mv :bounds fn2-fields)
      (let ,(fn2-rf-row-binds vnames nk 'vbase)
       (declare (ignorable ,@(fn2-rf-vars vnames)))
       (case kind ,@(fn2-rf-apply-arms evs value nk) (otherwise (mv :event fn2-fields))))))
    ;; The assigned args of event KIND from the decoded row at VBASE into
    ;; the arg rows at ABASE: :ok (a kind without assigns writes nothing),
    ;; :range, :event (not an event of the fold), :bounds.
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-ASSIGN") (kind vbase abase fn2-fields)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp vbase) (natp abase))))
     (if (not (and (natp vbase) (natp abase)
                   (<= (+ vbase ,(+ nk nv)) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (<= (+ abase ,(fn2-rf-max-args evs)) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
         (mv :bounds fn2-fields)
      (let ,(fn2-rf-row-binds vnames nk 'vbase)
       (declare (ignorable ,@(fn2-rf-vars vnames)))
       (case kind ,@(fn2-rf-assign-apply-arms evs)
        ,@(let ((plain (fn2-rf-plain-kinds evs))) (and plain `((,plain (mv :ok fn2-fields)))))
        (otherwise (mv :event fn2-fields))))))
    )))
forms.fn2-rf-logic-events:
(defun fn2-rf-logic-events (name key value fold)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let* ((evs (cadr (member-eq :events fold))) (vnames (strip-cars value)) (nv (len value))
        (obs (cadr (member-eq :observe fold))))
  `((fn2-fields-preserves ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-APPLY") (kind vbase abase fn2-fields) :position 1)
    (fn2-fields-preserves ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-ASSIGN") (kind vbase abase fn2-fields) :position 1)
    ;; The list side of the assignment: event E with its assigned args
    ;; computed from the key's value VALS, as (code event).
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-ASSIGN-SPEC") (vals e)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil) (ignorable vals))
     (let ,(fn2-rf-list-binds vnames 0 'vals)
      (declare (ignorable ,@(fn2-rf-vars vnames)))
      (case (car e) ,@(fn2-rf-assign-list-arms evs)
       ,@(let ((plain (fn2-rf-plain-kinds evs))) (and plain `((,plain (list :ok e)))))
       (otherwise (list :event e)))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-KEY") (e)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (case (car e) ,@(fn2-rf-key-arms evs key) (otherwise nil)))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-STEP") (vals e)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (let ,(fn2-rf-list-binds vnames 0 'vals)
      (declare (ignorable ,@(fn2-rf-vars vnames)))
      (case (car e) ,@(fn2-rf-step-arms evs value) (otherwise (mv :event vals)))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-KEYP") (q)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (fn2-rf-fitsp q ',(fn2-rf-key-widths key)))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-KEYSP") (qs)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (if (atom qs) (null qs) (and (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-KEYP") (car qs)) (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-KEYSP") (cdr qs)))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-ROWSP") (st)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (if (atom st) (null st)
      (and (consp (car st)) (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-KEYP") (caar st)) (fn2-rf-fitsp (cdar st) ',(fn2-rf-widths value))
           (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-ROWSP") (cdr st)))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-STATEP") (st)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (and (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-ROWSP") st) (no-duplicatesp-equal (strip-cars st))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-EVENTSP") (es)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (if (atom es) (null es) (and (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-EVENTP") (car es)) (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-EVENTSP") (cdr es)))))
    ;; The list fold: ST is an alist key -> value; an absent key reads as
    ;; zeros, so a row of zeros and no row observe alike.
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-VALUE") (st key)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (let ((r (assoc-equal key st))) (if r (cdr r) (make-list ,nv :initial-element 0))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-APPLY-SPEC") (st e)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (if (not (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-EVENTP") e)) st
      (b* ((key (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-KEY") e))
           ((mv code vals) (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-STEP") (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-VALUE") st key) e)))
       (if (eq code :ok) (put-assoc-equal key vals st) st))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-RUN") (st events)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (if (atom events) st (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-RUN") (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-APPLY-SPEC") st (car events)) (cdr events))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-SPEC") (events)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-RUN") nil events))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-OBSERVE") (st q)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (let ((vals (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-VALUE") st q)))
      (list ,@(fn2-rf-obs-list obs vnames))))
    (defun ,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-OBSERVE-ALL") (st qs)
     (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
     (if (atom qs) nil (cons (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-OBSERVE") st (car qs)) (,(fn2-rs-sym name "-FOLD-OBSERVE-ALL") st (cdr qs))))))))
forms.fn2-succ-put:
(defun fn2-succ-put (tx i sid kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) :guard t))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots))) (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*)
                    (< (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i) (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sid)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (member (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns)
                       (list *fn2-succ-phase-idle* *fn2-succ-phase-open* *fn2-succ-phase-staged*)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      (code (fn2-succ-kind-keyword->code kind))
      ((unless (natp code)) (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (< 0 (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0))) (mv :schema fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (cond ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)
                      (and (not (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid)) (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :latest :union))))
                     ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-depend*)
                      (or (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid) (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :latest))))
                     (t (natp (fn2-fold-arity sid kind)))))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i))
      (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-put s (phase *fn2-succ-slot-phase-put*) (sid sid) (kind code) (set 0) (events 0) (outs 0)
                                          (found 0) (vrun 0) (size 0) (oset 0) (sk 0) (ss 0) (sg 0) (late 0) (filled 0) (unchanged 0)))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (phase *fn2-succ-phase-open*) (ri 0)
                                        (rstate *fn2-succ-resolve-fresh*) (rbound 0))))
  (mv :ok fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)))
forms.fn2-succ-replay-records:
(defun fn2-succ-replay-records (k i off event wslot wgen wlen tx b0 okind oslot ogen fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-pool) :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp k))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-format-txn-record-decode fn2-run-layout-decode fn2-run-layout-size
                                            fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-succ-replay-event-mask fn2-succ-fill-zero-events
                                            fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp i) (natp off) (natp wlen) (natp tx) (natp b0)
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-ident* *fn2-format-sealed-batch-num-fields*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 wlen) (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((when (<= wlen off)) (mv (if (equal off wlen) :ok :length) fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((when (zp k)) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (fbase (+ b0 *fn2-idc-ident*))
      ((mv code next fn2-fields) (fn2-format-txn-record-decode fbase wslot wgen off wlen okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (natp next) (< off next))) (mv :format fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (kind (fn2-fields-value (+ fbase *fn2-format-txn-record-field-record-kind*) fn2-fields))
      (len (fn2-fields-value (+ fbase *fn2-format-txn-record-field-length*) fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp len) (<= (+ next len) wlen))) (mv :length fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (end (+ next len))
      ((when (equal kind *record-kind-article-acceptance*))
       (fn2-succ-replay-records (- k 1) i end event wslot wgen wlen tx b0 okind oslot ogen fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (and (natp kind) (< *fn2-commit-txn-schema-record-kind-base* kind)
                    (<= kind *fn2-commit-txn-schema-record-kind-last*)))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i))
      (entry (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i)))
      ((unless (and (< i *fn2-succ-slots*) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                    (<= (+ entry *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (sid (- kind *fn2-commit-txn-schema-record-kind-base*))
      ((mv code dend fn2-fields) (fn2-run-layout-decode sid 0 entry wslot wgen next end okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (equal dend end))) (mv :format fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (evmask (fn2-succ-replay-event-mask sid))
      (fn2-fields (if (and (posp evmask) (unsigned-byte-p 60 event))
                      (fn2-succ-fill-zero-events (nfix (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)) 0 entry evmask event fn2-fields)
                    fn2-fields))
      (rsize (fn2-run-layout-size sid 0 entry fn2-fields))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 32 rsize)) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-put s (phase *fn2-succ-slot-phase-resolved*) (sid sid) (kind *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)
                                          (set 0) (events 0) (outs 0) (found 0) (vrun 0) (size rsize) (oset 1)
                                          (sk okind) (ss oslot) (sg ogen) (late 0) (filled 0) (unchanged 0))))
  (fn2-succ-replay-records (- k 1) (+ 1 i) end event wslot wgen wlen tx b0 okind oslot ogen fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
